authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Recovery and Distribution of Surplus Food) Regulations, 2019

temperature_rules.requirement: Must be maintained above 60°C (140°F) during storage and transit, or consumed within 4 hours of preparation if kept at ambient temperature.
Must be rapidly cooled and maintained at or below 5°C (41°F) to prevent pathogen proliferation.
Must be kept at or below -18°C (0°F) with no signs of thawing and refreezing.

prohibited_high_risk_items: Uncooked seafood, raw meats, and poultry
Unpasteurized dairy products and raw milk
Food kept at ambient temperature exceeding 4 hours post-cooking
Canned foods showing bulging, dents, or leakage
Pre-cut fruits (melons, papaya) held at room temperature beyond 2 hours
Food handled with bare hands or showing foul odor, rancidity, or fungal growth
mandatory_checklist: Food has been prepared in a clean, hygienic kitchen compliant with FSSAI standards.
Food has been covered and shielded from dust, pests, and environmental contamination.
Prepared food has not exceeded the 4-hour ambient threshold.
Food is packed in clean, food-grade non-toxic stainless steel or virgin plastic containers.
Donor acknowledges accurate description of veg/non-veg and preparation timestamp.
